reviews.text:

reviews.title: Wrong information
reviews.text:
I bought this app because I was new on my plant journey and wanted all the information I could get on any new plant I had. Experienced growers laughed at me saying it was a waste of time. Not totally true. IF THE INFORMATION WAS ACCURATE. I have submitted corrections several times ( after double checking facts with pant encyclopedia and google and Reddit) 
The information is never fixed, SO.. how d I trust when I take a picture of a plant at a store to see if it's healthy?? How do I TRUST THE APP AT ALL? I don't care what others say, I use what works for me, but this I KNOW HAS INACCURATE INFO.
